title: Nucleic Acid Purification/Cloning
author: Opentrons
materials: Assembly plate is manually transferred from OT-2 deck to an external PCR thermocycler for a 1 hour incubation

steps.title: Add backbone mix to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 9 µL of backbone mix from slot 4 into each well of the Assembly plate in slot 3 using a 20 µL pipette; reuse the same tips for all wells and discard them after completing the step.

steps.title: Add fragment mix to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 µL of fragment mix from slot 2 into each well of the Assembly plate in slot 3, using a fresh tip for each well; discard each tip after dispensing.

steps.title: Add Gibson mix and mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of Gibson mix from slot 1 into each well of the Assembly plate in slot 3. Then mix the reaction by aspirating and dispensing 10 µL three times. Use a new tip for each well and discard after mixing.

steps.title: Incubate assembly plate
steps.instruction: Manually transfer the Assembly plate from the OT‑2 deck to an external PCR thermocycler and incubate for 1 hour.
